properties.name: A result refutes only on the owner's signed ruling; a claim it supports reads supported given what is held on purpose
properties.rationale: Accepted 2026-10-28: req:the-owner-can-rule-a-prediction-refuted-by-a-named-result under dec:a-result-refutes-a-prediction-only-on-the-owners-ruling-2026-10-28, and req:a-claim-a-result-supports-reads-supported-given-the-model-held-on-purpose. Act chosen after measuring the existing ones: a contested Decision keeps a dispute open, collapse_decision picks among alternatives, a reply answers an objection; the concession (req:a-reply-can-concede-an-objection-against-one-reading-and-move-to-another) is the act that grants an objection against what it attacks, so a ruling is a Decision that concedes the result, signed through set_decision_status's approver, which the signer rule already refuses for anyone but the caller. Reusing it adds no tool, argument or schema property; reply fields are additive. The 10-20 rule (dec:idea-an-objection-resting-on-evidence-contests-or-refutes) stands: evidence alone contests. Old designs read as before: the readings golden over 17 trial fixtures and the Shop-shaped designs did not move, none holds held_as or a concession, and a_design_using_neither_the_ruling_nor_held_as_reads_as_before pins it. 6 of the 9 new core tests fail on main 73b29e4df (3 pin unchanged readings). Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_018ibUbMKCS1yK5W17cncp9P
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: Gaps 1 and 2 of the design-a-phenomenon skill. (1) The owner's ruling on a result, with acts already served: a Decision that concedes the result (CONTRADICTS alignment conceding), accepted and signed by an approver, optionally concluded by a step from the result and the missed prediction. crates/reflow2-core/src/inference/ruling.rs reads it: while in force, what the result goes against reads refuted by the ruling, naming the ruling, signer, result and the premises held on purpose beneath the target and the ruling's step; a hypothesis discharged into or derived under them reads refuted with it. ObjectionReading gains `ruling`; reasoning_report `refuted_by_ruling`; ReasoningDebt (loop_status reasoning) `rulings` / `rulings_in_force`; InferenceWalk and BlastRadius (propagate_from, propagate_change) `rulings_lost`. A Decision conceding a result counts only as a ruling. (2) inference.rs `supported_given`: a reading that would be conditional, with a line resting on evidence and otherwise only on premises held as model or principle, reads proof_status `supported` with `given`; reasoning_report truth `supported` with `given`; the step's holds_as `supported`. The design-a-phenomenon skill (and mirrors) teaches both and drops the two honest limits; skill_lint allows the new field terms; relations.yaml's follows declares AUTHORED_BY. Tests: a_result_refutes_only_on_the_owners_ruling.rs (core, 9) and the phenomenon wire test.
